functions.name: security_campaigns
functions.description: Organization-qualified security remediation campaigns, with complete typed user managers, team managers and observed alert statistics. Managers are distinct from alert authors or dismissal reviewers. Open/closed alert totals are membership observations and may overlap across campaigns.

metrics.name: security_campaign_count
metrics.comment: Selected security_campaigns rows at the declared entity grain.

metrics.name: open_security_campaign_count
metrics.comment: Selected security_campaigns rows at the declared entity grain. Restricted to state=open.

metrics.name: closed_security_campaign_count
metrics.comment: Selected security_campaigns rows at the declared entity grain. Restricted to state=closed.

security_campaign_open_alert_occurrences.comment: Sum of reported campaign alert memberships; alerts can belong to more than one campaign. Missing statistics remain unknown.

security_campaign_closed_alert_occurrenc.comment: Sum of reported campaign alert memberships; alerts can belong to more than one campaign. Missing statistics remain unknown.

security_campaign_in_progress_alert_occu.comment: Sum of reported campaign alert memberships; alerts can belong to more than one campaign. Missing statistics remain unknown.

functions.name: dependabot_dismissal_requests
functions.description: Canonical GHEC Dependabot dismissal requests unified across organization, repository and exact alert scopes. Request ID, request number and alert number are distinct. Nested response reviewers remain distinct from the requester. selected_alert_number is populated only from the exact alert endpoint selector; source data.alert_number stays VARCHAR. Collection counts cover the explicit lookback window.

metrics.name: dependabot_dismissal_request_count
metrics.comment: Requests in the selected lookback window (repository default month; organization default day), not all historical requests.

metrics.name: dependabot_pending_dismissal_request_count
metrics.comment: Selected dependabot_dismissal_requests rows at the declared entity grain. Restricted to status=pending. Collection lookback defaults to month for repositories and day for organizations, not complete history.

metrics.name: dependabot_approved_dismissal_request_count
metrics.comment: Selected dependabot_dismissal_requests rows at the declared entity grain. Restricted to status=approved. Collection lookback defaults to month for repositories and day for organizations, not complete history.

metrics.name: dependabot_denied_dismissal_request_count
metrics.comment: Selected dependabot_dismissal_requests rows at the declared entity grain. Restricted to status=denied. Collection lookback defaults to month for repositories and day for organizations, not complete history.

metrics.name: dependabot_expired_dismissal_request_count
metrics.comment: Selected dependabot_dismissal_requests rows at the declared entity grain. Restricted to status=expired. Collection lookback defaults to month for repositories and day for organizations, not complete history.
